pages.title: Forgewright - Self-hosted CI/CD for engineering teams

sections.purpose: Present the value proposition of Forgewright
sections.copy: Build, test, and deploy with confidence. Forgewright is an open-source self-hosted CI/CD pipeline runner designed for engineering teams who need control, reliability, and performance.
